beta13.2.description:
### Sorry to keep you waiting!

# Anyhow, this patch is LONG overdue, BUT here it is! This slice of life comes with:
## Engine:
* Actually remembered to add the Playlists option to the Category Menu
* Playlists themselves actually work again
* Shuffle no longer breaks the playlist after completing it
* The engine will now create a mods folder if one cannot be found
* The engine will now create a playlists folder if one cannot be found (placed in the main folder, but can also be placed in mods, as well as inside mod folders)
* NEW FEATURE for playlists: Challenge Playlist Generator (this will scan all of your songs, and make a playlist with a random amount of the "hardest" songs you have)
* NEW OPTION: Finalize at Birth (if you have Preload Song enabled, this will make it so that the notes are only fully loaded when the note is to be spawned. DO NOT TURN THIS ON IF YOU DO NOT HAVE Preload Song ENABLED! Also, sustains will rarely crash the game. Just ignore it.)
* There is a rare chance you will be offered a challenge when booting up the engine
* Skipping the intro will no longer work if a cutscene is active
* The playlist menu no longer sets the BPM when attempting to preview a song
* The splash screen now properly displays videos
* Notes can now have custom Cause of Death attached to them (simply modify the COD variable within the note)
* NEW FREEPLAY MENU: Dynamic Freeplay (live-loads the song list as opposed to waiting for the list to be completed before loading. WARNING: YOU MUST WAIT FOR IT TO FINISH LOADING, OR ELSE IT'LL TRY TO LOAD THE SONG FROM THE INCORRECT DIRECTORY!)
* You can now summon a console with F6
* The Freeplay Manager now precaches songs (freeplay should load a bit faster now)
* Fixed more of the Base/Erect stages
* Blazin' is still broken, but doesn't immediately crash anymore, so hey, that's something at least
* Fixed a bug in the Category Menu that removed any category with a space in it
* Fixed most of the songs not being in the right category
* The Achievements can now actually be achieved (I don't know HOW I messed that up)
* Reworked the Note Tween system (it ain't perfect, but it shouldn't be as bad anymore)
* Fixed BF being improperly positioned in V-Slice Freeplay
* You can now modify the visualizers on the health bar in scripts (via `visual`, `vocalvisual`, and `oppvisual` respectively)
* You no longer get an additional miss during AP for no reason
* Spritemaps work better than they used to (They still don't entirely work, but I'm working on it)
* The engine will now register natural noteskin locations for 0.6.x mods
* Alphabet now properly handles text commands
* AP Note Check notes now have their own Noteskin
* Adjusted the Audio Offset Systems a bit
* Updated a few libraries
* Added an option for people playing on Wineskin to reset the Mixtape Engine Directory to fix failed file location errors
* The Pico Erect Cutscene now properly works (with help from @lmecraft41)
* The Health Icon JSON's now actually work as intended
* You can now modify the ability to skip the intro (via the `needSkip` variable)
* Reworked the FPS system
* Pixel Notes no longer forcibly disable the RGB Shader
* New Lua Function: `getColorFromRGB({R, G, B})`
* Fixed the Cause of Death system
* Added a few new Cause of Death quotes
* Global Mods now have a Yellow-tinted icon to discern them better
* Note Fields now have their own separate FPS option
* Updated Modchart System
* Added new HScript Function: `degtorad`
* Re-added the Mods Category to the Categories Menu (don't ask me why it was removed, I have no idea)
* Gave a certain man a certain achievement (Have you spoken with him yet? If not, say his name in the Title Screen. You're Welcome =) )
* Songs no longer break when returning from the Options Menu during a song
* Fixed icon layering issue
* Added settings to the Warm-Up prompt
* Remembered to disable the debug keys (the Character Editor and Chart Editor keybinds are still there)

## AP:
* "Fixed" the Tutorial Trap getting stuck in botplay after finishing Tutorial (untested, may not actually be fixed)
* Updated AP World
* The player name of a YAML will now be autocorrected if it doesn't match the name in the player name slot when being imported
* The game should no longer randomly lose connection when waiting/returning to the Category Menu
* Character/Stage Sanity now accounts for Playlists as well
* AP Note Check notes hit by the opponent no longer crash the game
* Removed a thread that was causing issues when loading into Freeplay during AP
* Chart Modifiers should now actually reset properly
* Setting your Archipelago folder location now actually works properly
* Playlists now actually send out all items on completion (will be tweaked later)
* The Spin effect now actually turns off
* Made BF float a little faster
* ### ACTUALLY REMEMBERED TO PUT THE APWORLD HERE (definitely here the whole time yup yup)

With all that said, I'll also put this here: A Rewrite of the engine is in the works! While it's still just me and Yuta, if any coders are willing to help out, please let me know.

Alright, enough yapping for me, I'm going to bed. Take your patch and have fun, ya goobers

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Z11Coding/Mixtape-Engine-Rework/compare/beta13.1...beta13.2
